# Epistle of Barnabas — Chapter 14 (EMET Literal)

**Source:** Codex Sinaiticus, Epistle of Barnabas 14
**Agent:** EMET (Literal)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. Good. But I will show you also this: what is the covenant, and to whom and in what manner has it been given?
2. The law was indeed given through Moses, but it was given for them. But the covenant was given to us. But consider how it was received. Moses received it as a servant; but for us the Lord himself has given the covenant of the new people, in order that we may be the people that knows him.
3. And therefore our hope is also in Jesus, that through his own sufferings he has prepared the new covenant for us; so that he might show — since the promise that was made to the fathers and there was no one who was worthy to receive it — that he himself has come to abolish death and to redeem the promise.
4. And further, being revealed to them who were persecuting and putting to death his prophets — since he himself endured on their account — in order that he might redeem them from death, he was revealed at the end of time.
5. So then, he appeared so as to complete the full measure of the sins of those who had persecuted his prophets to death.
6. For this reason he appeared also to reveal himself, that he might call us who have been prepared by God beforehand, so that when we were being prepared, he would be revealed, since we did not have sin, but were not righteous either — but we had been prepared to receive the Lord.
7. And therefore being gathered to receive the gift of the forgiveness of sins, we have received for ourselves the name of the new people of God.
